Elfsong/Cisco_CCNA.title: Networking
Elfsong/Cisco_CCNA.note: 343 CCNA exam questions (volume1 187, volume2 156). Used ONLY to check that fine-tuning did not make the model forget general networking. Licence not stated.

zilalzihar/mikrotik-routeros-qa-dataset.title: MikroTik RouterOS Q&A
zilalzihar/mikrotik-routeros-qa-dataset.note: instruction/input/output/source. Apache-2.0. Good fit for the MikroTik command gap (RootIQ's own KB has 22 RouterOS commands). Check the `source` column and spot-check answers before mixing.

witfoo/syslog-to-artifact.title: Syslog -> structured artifact
witfoo/syslog-to-artifact.note: 155k rows of raw syslog to WitFoo artifact JSON (Apache-2.0). Different output schema from RootIQ's normalized event, so use it as a small (<=5%) auxiliary mix to teach log structure, not as the syslog task itself.

NetConfEval/NetConfEval.title: Network configuration benchmarks
NetConfEval/NetConfEval.note: MIT. Config generation / policy translation benchmarks, not vendor troubleshooting. Relevant for a future `config` agent.

rachid-abdou/NetConfEval.title: NetConfEval, augmented
rachid-abdou/NetConfEval.note: CC-BY-4.0 (attribution required). Same purpose as NetConfEval.

shaunak1234/snmp-diagnostic-agent-traces.title: SNMP diagnostic agent traces
shaunak1234/snmp-diagnostic-agent-traces.note: Apache-2.0. 2,136 tool-calling trajectories (train 1,459 / val 197 / test 480). A different format (messages + tools): useful later to teach tool-use for a diagnostic agent.

AliMaatouk/TelecomTS.title: Telecom KPI time series
AliMaatouk/TelecomTS.note: MIT. 5G telecom KPIs with Q&A. Not switch-related; only relevant for time-series anomaly explanations.

ndavidson/cisco_inam_chatml.title: Cisco Q&A (33k)
ndavidson/cisco_inam_chatml.note: Built from Cisco product documentation and no licence is stated. Fine for private experiments, do not ship a model trained on it.

vivek-dodia/mikrotik-docs.title: MikroTik documentation sections
vivek-dodia/mikrotik-docs.note: Tagged MIT, but the content is the vendor's own documentation: use for retrieval/reading, not as training text.

jack0503/junos_cli_qa.title: Junos CLI Q&A (29.8k)
jack0503/junos_cli_qa.note: No licence stated; derived from Juniper documentation. Excluded until the licence is clarified.

jack0503/junos_cli_command.title: Junos CLI command reference (11.5k)
jack0503/junos_cli_command.note: No licence stated; derived from Juniper documentation. Excluded until the licence is clarified.

Coldyuja/junos-user-manual-markdown-raw.title: Junos manuals (markdown)
Coldyuja/junos-user-manual-markdown-raw.note: Raw vendor manual text, no licence stated.

bolu61/loghub_2.title: LogHub 2 (unofficial mirror)
bolu61/loghub_2.note: Unofficial upload, single `text` column, no licence. Use the official LogHub release from logpai if generic log data is ever needed.

Qwen/Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507.title: Default base model
Qwen/Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507.note: Apache-2.0. Fits a Colab T4 in 4-bit. Multilingual, follows the JSON output formats well.

humain-ai/ALLaM-7B-Instruct-preview.title: Arabic/Saudi base model
humain-ai/ALLaM-7B-Instruct-preview.note: Apache-2.0. Better Arabic; needs an L4/A100. Same fine-tuning code (BASE_KEY = 'allam').

intfloat/multilingual-e5-small.title: Embedding model (small)
intfloat/multilingual-e5-small.note: MIT. Candidate to replace TF-IDF in the Knowledge agent; needs the prefixes 'query: ' / 'passage: '.

BAAI/bge-m3.title: Embedding model (multilingual, long input)
BAAI/bge-m3.note: MIT. Strongest of the shortlist for Arabic + English retrieval; largest.

BAAI/bge-reranker-v2-m3.title: Re-ranker
BAAI/bge-reranker-v2-m3.note: Apache-2.0. Re-order the top-k retrieved passages before the Copilot uses them.
